purpose: Shared cases for the conversation evidence rules (2026-10-22 hallucination fix). Code parses the child's find requests and location reports; model chat replies may not assert where an object is now, that it is present or absent, or that the assistant perceived anything; image descriptions keep only hedged sentences or sentences whose objects the phone's detectors agreed on. server/src/companion-guards.mjs and BlindCore (CompanionUtterance, ConversationClaimGuard, VisualGrounding) must agree on every case. Includes the actual failed replies recorded in ios/validation/companion-chat/text-chat-status.json.
